## Use When

Use when a v2 page needs a title, eyebrow, and short description.

## Do

- Use PageHeader once at the top of the page surface.
- Keep copy concise and operational.
- Let banners and summaries follow the header.

## Do Not

- Turn the page header into a promotional hero.
- Repeat Banner copy in the description.

## Example

Settings pages can introduce the configuration domain before the form.
